tests.name: each queue item exposes one appropriate primary action with secondary actions collapsed
task menu survives progress refresh, keyboard dismissal and a narrow window
the native context submenu has three entries and adapts to single or multiple papers
the unified reading entry reopens an existing draft or routes multiple papers to the picker without starting work
one native button clears finished cache and history without interrupting another running task
PDF, saved note, memberships, unconfirmed and unimported tasks stay intact
local receipt suppresses duplicate intake and note discovery survives without local history
modified drafts and missing-note lookups retain both their histories and caches with reasons
cache referenced by a running paper is preserved while finished history can be cleared
cleaned history stays hidden after reloading the persisted queue and no model calls occur
only an explicit archive reopen brings a cleared task back without rereading
